premises: Trace oxygen and nitrogen interstitials in TiVNbTa promote phase segregation during high-temperature exposure.
Phase segregation depletes the matrix of solute interstitials, causing progressive softening.
Reducing oxygen and nitrogen content will prevent impurity-driven phase segregation.
Preventing phase segregation will maintain solid solution strengthening and high-temperature strength.
